column1: # Target kernel files of the map (#1), for scripts/census/report.py. Tab-separated; a line starting with # is a comment.
#   1 family      K-T Triton-distributed tutorials 01-08, K-D DeepEP, K-M all-to-all MoE, K-N nanoGPT,
#                 K-L TileLang counterparts of existing examples, K-S TileScale overlap kernels, V3 consistency cases
#   2 front end   Triton, Triton-distributed, TileLang, TileScale, or PyTorch for the nanoGPT model itself
#   4 commit      full hash of the pin; empty when no repository or no pin applies
#   5 path        file in that repository; empty when the target has no file there or its source is undecided
#   6 note        what the file is; for a row without a path, the reason
# A file named by two families has two rows and is scanned once. A row with a path is scanned whole: the report
# counts every kernel of the file, whether or not the target reaches it.
